name: cloudflare
description: Publishes static exports to Cloudflare Workers or Pages and attaches reviewed custom domains using your saved Cloudflare connection. Workers sites with active forms store submissions in a D1 database in your Cloudflare account for Tovu to pull. Preview reads current infrastructure; domain changes require human confirmation.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Publish static exports with Workers or Pages and review apex/www domain changes before applying them.
